I've saved it: your sister's new cat is called **Poremon**. GBrain had nothing about her before, and recalling it right after saving returned the fact (fact #35, filed under `people/users-sister`, marked as something you said in this chat).

If you tell me your sister's name, I'll file the fact under her name so it's easier to find.

This turn also closed the last open check from the install. GBrain's per-turn reminder arrived with your message, and the GBrain tools now show up and work in this conversation. The marker fact saved earlier from the command line came back through those tools here. Since that check passed, I deleted the two install-test facts (#1 and #2).

Search is still keyword-only, so a question worded very differently from the saved fact could miss it.
